newsitem.title: USA: Silicon Graphics' Cray hits NEC over suit.
newsitem.headline: Silicon Graphics' Cray hits NEC over suit.

text.p: Cray Research Inc on Friday criticized NEC Corp for suing to prevent the U.S. Department of Commerce from investigating an antidumping complaint Cray filed against NEC.
Cray said NEC is circumventing established procedures for resolving such complaints.

"NEC's action will only further delay the supercomputer procurement initiated by the University Center for Atmospheric Research," said Cray president Robert Ewald. "NEC's unfair pricing and illegal practices will further prolong the disruption of the supercomputing industry and delay end-user abilities to further advance their respective sciences," he said.
The NEC suit, filed October 15 in the Court of International Trade, seeks to prevent the Commerce Department from investigating documented complaints of dumping, Cray said.
Cray Research is a subsidiary of Silicon Graphics Inc.
